label: Instacart Ads
terms_note: Publisher-side Carrot Ads API requires an access token; advertiser API terms not read

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (POST /v2/oauth/token with client ID + secret from Instacart; Ads Manager user with 'API Authentication' role)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (advertiser API behind Ads Manager API-authentication users; publisher Carrot Ads API documented in full).
auth: 1. Ads Manager account → add a user with **API Authentication**; assign Edit on Campaign Management and Read on Customer Insights Reporting.
2. Instacart issues client ID + secret; `POST /v2/oauth/token` `grant_type=client_credentials` (scope empty for all, `connect:ian` for Carrot Ads only) → bearer.
3. Call the advertiser endpoints (campaigns, ad groups, products, reports — TODO(verify) paths).
reference.limits: - Rate limits not stated; access by Instacart-issued credentials; free.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: https://docs.instacart.com/ads/api/authentication/ documents POST /v2/oauth/token for the Carrot Ads API ('scope … connect:ian for ads only'), which is the retailer/publisher ads-serving API (sponsored_products, display_placements, track) on a host 'Instacart assigned for your integration'. No public reference exists for an advertiser campaign, budget or report API (brands use Ads Manager), so nothing is mapped.
